rename.to: Should only fire output property once even if both in [outputs] and decorated w/ @Output

body: FWIW this was reported a few days ago, but it was closed immediatly https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/4611
Is there a use case for having both? I would consider this a mistake in the code and would like the framework to tell me by throwing an exception.
I think we should throw an error when the same event is registered more then once.
That's ok too. I'm more of a "be tolerant in what you accept person" myself but that policy can lead us into trouble and maybe it would here. Lets do something😊

issue.title: fix(directive): throw if output the same event more than once

issue.title: Angular attempts to subscribe to Event stream more than once
Multiple event sent on ".next()"
issue.body:
Hello,

I want to apologize first if someone ask it before, I did a lot of searches, and I didn't find an answer, so.. as I don't know if that's an issue or not, I post it there.

I have, for many events (but not all) the following issue : 
My listeners are called 2 times whereas I only send it once (I'm sure about it, I did a lot of tests) when I call next({}).

An example ?
The call : https://github.com/Peekmo/angular2-leap/blob/master/src/app/components/link-element/link-element.ts#L38
The template that call the component : https://github.com/Peekmo/angular2-leap/blob/master/src/app/components/page/page.html#L7
The function that is called twice for one .next() : https://github.com/Peekmo/angular2-leap/blob/master/src/app/components/page/page.ts#L23 (note : I'm forced to do that ugly timeout to avoid to do 2 times the same thing)

Is that normal ? Do I do something wrong ? (I have some listener in the same app that are only called once, and other twice so that's weird..)
If you never heard about that, that's probably an issue into my app.

Thank you ! :+1:
